# Free Manga Downloader 3 (FMD3 / FMD三) — LLM Documentation Directory

> FMD3 San (三) is a high-performance headless daemon, CLI, and modern Web UI rewrite in Rust of the Free Manga Downloader project. It runs on Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes homelabs, supporting 429+ website scraper modules, dual Lua/WebAssembly engines, SQLite FTS5 catalog search, NATS JetStream distributed queues, and ComicInfo.xml archive packaging for Komga and Kavita.

## Core Capabilities & Architecture

- **Language & Runtime**: 100% safe Rust (2021 edition), Tokio async runtime, Axum HTTP server, Leptos 0.7 SSR frontend.
- **Dual Scraping Engine**:
  - Legacy Lua 5.4 VM: Full Pascal FMD2 runtime emulation (`TXQuery`, `LuaStringList`, crypto, Duktape JavaScript engine, C Protobuf `pb.c`).
  - Next-gen WebAssembly: Sandboxed Wasmtime 29 runtime with fuel metering, linear memory boundaries, and typed host/guest ABI.
- **Distributed Queue**: Local in-memory queue or distributed NATS JetStream (`fmd worker`).
- **Storage & Metadata**: SQLite with FTS5 full-text indexing, automatic `ComicInfo.xml` generation for CBZ/EPUB archives.
- **Cloud-Native Deployment**: Official Helm Chart (`charts/fmd3`), multi-stage Dockerfile, Docker Compose, and Nix Flake.

## CLI Quick Reference

```bash
# Start daemon & web server on port 8088
fmd serve --port 8088 --bind 0.0.0.0

# Scan and list all 429+ scraper modules
fmd modules

# Validate and diagnose a scraper module
fmd modules --check MangaPlus --url "https://mangaplus.shueisha.co.jp/titles/100020"

# List and check tracked favorite manga
fmd favorites --list
fmd favorites --check --auto-download

# Query the local full-text search catalog
fmd catalog --query "One Piece"

# Synchronize website catalog into SQLite FTS5
fmd catalog --sync novelcool_fr

# Start a distributed background worker connected to NATS JetStream
fmd worker --nats nats://localhost:4222 --concurrency 4
```
